title: Ye kahani phir sahi
body:
Kis ne kab kalma parha-tha, Ye kahani phir sahi
Kon kab maidaan se bhaaga, Ye kahani phir sahi
<<DIVIDER>>
Fatima ke dar pe taarey ko utar-ta dekh kar
Kis ka kayse utra chehra, Ye kahani phir sahi
<<DIVIDER>>
Bas ye kaafi he Ali Khaybar ulat kar aa gaye
Kis ne kitna maal loota, Ye kahani phir sahi
<<DIVIDER>>
Zulfiqar e Haidary se bach gaya tha Amr-e-aas
Haan magar kayse bacha tha, Ye kahani phir sahi
<<DIVIDER>>
Umr bhar naraaz jis-se Binte Payghambar rahi
Us shaqi ka naam kya tha, Ye kahani phir sahi
<<DIVIDER>>
Mat karo aapas me jhagra, he ye paigham e Habib
Me huwa tha kayse zinda, Ye kahani phir sahi
<<DIVIDER>>
Jis asaa ke aasare par Umr bhar Moosa rahe
Us asaa par kya likha tha, Ye kahani phir sahi
<<DIVIDER>>
Parda e ghaybat se jab bhi aayega mera Imam
Kis ka pehle sar urhega, Ye kahani phir sahi
<<DIVIDER>>
Uss me ghayron ke nahi, apnon ke bhi naam ayenge
Kon he dushman Ali ka, Ye kahani phir sahi
<<DIVIDER>>
Kon tha meraj me Sajjad mehv e guftagu
Rehne do parde ka parda, Ye kahani phir sahi
author: Mir Hassan Mir
